title: Full faithfulness of the affine structure-algebra functor
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Let $F$ be a functor from the opposite of the category of schemes affine over $S$ [pqf-def-affine-morphism] to quasi-coherent sheaves of commutative $\mathcal O_S$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf, pqf-def-coherent]. Suppose its value on each $f:X\to S$ is $f_*\mathcal O_X$, and on every $S$-morphism $h:X\to Y$ its components are the section maps $h^\sharp$ (transported along the specified object equalities). Then $F$ is full and faithful.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 01SA; Constructions, Lemmas 01LT and 01LY; the local argument of original step 6

proof.text: *Step 6 (part (3): the functor is fully faithful).* Let $f:X\to S$, $g:Y\to S$ be affine over $S$; for an affine open $U\subseteq S$ put $X_U=f^{-1}U$, $Y_U=g^{-1}U$, both affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism]. (i) By [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-into-affine-scheme] ($Y_U$ affine, $Y_U\cong\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(Y_U)$) $k\mapsto k^\sharp$ is a bijection from morphisms $X_U\to Y_U$ to ring maps $\Gamma(Y_U)\to\Gamma(X_U)$; and $k$ is over $U$ iff $g\circ k=f$ on $X_U$, iff (both being morphisms into the affine $U$, same lemma) $k^\sharp\circ g^\sharp_U=f^\sharp_U$, i.e. iff $k^\sharp$ is an $\mathcal O_S(U)$-algebra map. (ii) Faithful: if $S$-morphisms $h,h':X\to Y$ have $g_*h^\sharp=g_*h'^\sharp$, then for every affine $U$ the restrictions $X_U\to Y_U$ have the same ring map, hence are equal by (i); the $X_U$ cover $X$, so $h=h'$ by [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing]. (iii) Full: let $\varphi:g_*\mathcal O_Y\to f_*\mathcal O_X$ be an $\mathcal O_S$-algebra map. For affine $U$ let $k_U:X_U\to Y_U$ be the $U$-morphism with $k_U^\sharp=\varphi_U$ (by (i)). For affine $V\subseteq U$, $k_U|_{X_V}$ and $k_V$ (followed by $Y_V\subseteq Y_U$) are morphisms $X_V\to Y_U$ into an affine scheme with ring maps $\mathrm{res}\circ\varphi_U$ and $\varphi_V\circ\mathrm{res}$, equal by naturality of $\varphi$; so they are equal. For affine $U,U'$, $X_U\cap X_{U'}=f^{-1}(U\cap U')$ is covered by the $X_V$ with $V\subseteq U\cap U'$ affine, on each of which $k_U$ and $k_{U'}$ both equal $k_V$; so $k_U$ and $k_{U'}$ agree on $X_U\cap X_{U'}$ by [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing] (uniqueness), and the same lemma glues the $k_U$ to $h:X\to Y$ with $h|_{X_U}=k_U$. Then $g\circ h=f$ (they agree on every $X_U$), and $g_*h^\sharp$ and $\varphi$ agree on every affine $U$ (both are $\varphi_U$), hence are equal by [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-morphism-on-basis](a). The hypotheses hobj and hmap identify the abstract functor F with these object and section formulas, so the local bijections prove F.Full and F.Faithful.
